title: Agentic Electronic Design Automation: A Handoff Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2606.19795v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Electronic design automation (EDA) is multi-stage and handoff-heavy, relying on transfers among humans, design artifacts, and multiple tools. LLM-based agents now participate in these transfers, yet the resulting research landscape is highly fragmented and lacks a unified perspective. This survey adopts the primary input--output pair as its organizing lens: for each agent system, we analyze its primary, supporting, and intermediate handoff objects and classify it according to the provenance of its primary input and the consumer boundary of its primary output. Intra-stage systems operate on objects within a single EDA stage, inter-stage systems transform EDA-native artifacts into forms usable by downstream stages, and extra-stage systems translate human intent into EDA artifacts. translated_title: 智能体化电子设计自动化：一种交接视角
translated_abstract: 电子设计自动化（EDA）是多阶段且高度依赖交接的流程，需要在人类、设计工件和多种工具之间进行传递。基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体如今已参与到这些传递过程中，然而由此形成的研究图景高度碎片化，缺乏统一的视角。本综述采用主要输入—输出对作为组织视角：针对每个智能体系统，我们分析其主要、辅助和中间交接对象，并根据其主要输入的来源和主要输出的消费边界对其进行分类。阶段内系统在单一EDA阶段内部的对象上进行操作，阶段间系统将EDA原生工件转换为下游阶段可用的形式，阶段外系统则将人类意图转化为EDA工件。基于这一分类法，我们调研了115个代表性系统，并从研究趋势、基准测试、模态等多个维度对它们进行了考察。
tldr: 该综述提出以“交接”为核心视角，基于主要输入—输出对将LLM智能体EDA系统统一分类为阶段内、阶段间和阶段外三类，并系统调研了115个代表性系统，弥合了该领域碎片化的研究图景。
en_tdlr: This survey introduces a handoff-centric taxonomy based on primary input-output pairs—classifying LLM-based agentic EDA systems into intra-stage, inter-stage, and extra-stage categories—and systematically reviews 115 representative systems to unify the fragmented research landscape.
